sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Pramendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant.
 Shri Nalini Gurung, learned Panel Lawyer for respondent/St  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in custody since 06.07.2025 in connection with Crime No.24/2024 registered at P.S.-Janeh District Rewa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376 of IPC and 5/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix aged about 16 years.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 02.06.2025.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
It is further submitted that the prosecutrix herself, clearly stated that no forceful sexual intercourse was committed upon her.
No injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.
It is also urged that there are material contradictions in the prosecutrix's statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. Prosecutrix is consenting party.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50345 2 MCRC-34389-2025 5.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.

9. Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10.
Certified copy as per rules.
